nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics — Grade 10 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Investigation or project (15%) and Test (14%)

nodes.title: Rational and irrational numbers
nodes.description: Understand that real numbers can be rational or irrational

nodes.title: Surds between integers
nodes.description: Establish between which two integers a given simple surd lies

nodes.title: Rounding real numbers
nodes.description: Round real numbers to an appropriate degree of accuracy

nodes.title: Binomial by trinomial multiplication
nodes.description: Multiplication of a binomial by a trinomial

nodes.title: Factorisation
nodes.description: Factorisation to include types taught in Grade 9 and: trinomials, grouping in pairs, sum and difference of two cubes

nodes.title: Algebraic fractions
nodes.description: Simplifying, adding and subtracting algebraic fractions using factorisation with denominators of cubes (limited to sum and difference of cubes)

nodes.title: Laws of exponents
nodes.description: Revise laws of exponents learnt in Grade 9 where x, y > 0 and m, n are integers. Also by definition: x^(-n) = 1/x^n (x != 0) and x^0 = 1 (x != 0)

nodes.title: Simplify expressions and solve equations using exponent laws
nodes.description: Use the laws of exponents to simplify expressions and solve equations, accepting that the rules also hold for m, n in Q

nodes.title: Linear equations
nodes.description: Revise the solution of linear equations

nodes.title: Quadratic equations
nodes.description: Solve quadratic equations (by factorisation)

nodes.title: Simultaneous linear equations
nodes.description: Solve simultaneous linear equations in two unknowns

nodes.title: Word problems
nodes.description: Solve word problems involving linear, quadratic or simultaneous linear equations

nodes.title: Literal equations
nodes.description: Solve literal equations (changing the subject of a formula)

nodes.title: Linear inequalities
nodes.description: Solve linear inequalities (and show solution graphically). Interval notation must be known

nodes.title: Trigonometric ratios
nodes.description: Define the trigonometric ratios sin, cos and tan using the right-angled triangle

nodes.title: Extended definitions
nodes.description: Extend the definitions of sin, cos and tan for 0 <= theta <= 360 degrees

nodes.title: Reciprocal ratios
nodes.description: Define the reciprocal trigonometric ratios cosec, sec and cot using the right-angled triangle (examined in Grade 10 only)

nodes.title: Special angles
nodes.description: Derive values of the trigonometric ratios for the special cases (without using a calculator) for theta in {0, 30, 45, 60, 90} degrees

nodes.title: 2D problems with right-angled triangles
nodes.description: Solve two-dimensional problems involving right-angled triangles

nodes.title: Trigonometric equations
nodes.description: Solve simple trigonometric equations for angles between 0 and 90 degrees

nodes.title: Diagram-based ratio values
nodes.description: Use a diagram to determine the numerical values of ratios for angles from 0 to 360 degrees

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment (15%) and mid-year exam (14%)

nodes.title: Revision of lines, angles and triangles
nodes.description: Revise basic results established in earlier grades regarding lines, angles and triangles, especially the similarity and congruence of triangles

nodes.title: Special quadrilaterals
nodes.description: Define the following special quadrilaterals: kite, parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square and trapezium. Investigate and make conjectures about the properties of the sides, angles, diagonals and areas of these quadrilaterals. Prove these conjectures

nodes.title: Midpoint theorem
nodes.description: Investigate line segment joining the midpoints of two sides of a triangle

nodes.title: Problems and riders
nodes.description: Solve problems and prove riders using the properties of parallel lines, triangles, quadrilaterals and midpoint theorem

nodes.title: Distance, gradient and midpoint formulae
nodes.description: Represent quadrilaterals amongst other geometric figures on a Cartesian co-ordinate system. Derive and apply for any two points (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) the formulae for calculating the: distance between the two points, gradient of the line segment connecting the two points (and from that identify parallel and perpendicular lines), coordinates of the mid-point of the line segment joining the two points

nodes.title: Concept of a function
nodes.description: The concept of a function, where a certain quantity (output value) uniquely depends on another quantity (input value). Work with relationships between variables using tables, graphs, words and formulae. Convert flexibly between these representations

nodes.title: Graph of y = x (revision)
nodes.description: The graph defined by y = x should be known from Grade 9

nodes.title: Basic graph plotting
nodes.description: Point by point plotting of basic graphs defined by y = x^2, y = 1/x and y = b^x (b > 0, b != 1) to discover shape, domain (input values), range (output values), asymptotes, axes of symmetry, turning points and intercepts on the axes (where applicable)

nodes.title: Effect of a and q on graphs
nodes.description: Investigate the effect of a and q on the graphs defined by y = a.f(x) + q, where f(x) = x, f(x) = x^2, f(x) = 1/x and f(x) = b^x (b > 0, b != 1)

nodes.title: Trigonometric graphs plotting
nodes.description: Point by point plotting of basic graphs defined by y = sin(theta), y = cos(theta) and y = tan(theta) for theta in [0, 360] degrees

nodes.title: Effect of a and q on trigonometric graphs
nodes.description: Study the effect of a and q on the graphs defined by: y = a sin(theta) + q, y = a cos(theta) + q, and y = a tan(theta) + q where a and q are rational and theta in [0, 360] degrees

nodes.title: Sketch and interpret graphs
nodes.description: Sketch graphs, find the equations of given graphs and interpret graphs. Sketching must be based on the observation of the effects studied

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Test (14%) and Test (14%)

nodes.title: 2D problems with right-angled triangles
nodes.description: Solve two-dimensional problems involving right-angled triangles

nodes.title: Problems in two dimensions
nodes.description: Problems in two dimensions

nodes.title: Measures of central tendency (ungrouped)
nodes.description: Measures of central tendency in ungrouped data. Calculate the mean. Determine the median and the mode

nodes.title: Measures of central tendency (grouped)
nodes.description: Measures of central tendency in grouped data: Calculation of mean estimate of grouped data and identification of modal interval and interval in which the median lies

nodes.title: Measures of dispersion
nodes.description: Range as a measure of dispersion and extension to include percentiles, quartiles, inter-quartile and semi-inter-quartile range

nodes.title: Five number summary and box-and-whisker
nodes.description: Five number summary (maximum, minimum and quartiles) and box and whisker diagram

nodes.title: Analyse and interpret data
nodes.description: Use the statistical summaries (measures of central tendency and dispersion), and graphs to analyse and make meaningful comments on the context associated with the given data

nodes.title: Histogram
nodes.description: Histogram

nodes.title: Probability models
nodes.description: The use of probability models to compare the relative frequency of events with the theoretical probability

nodes.title: Venn diagrams and probability rules
nodes.description: The use of Venn diagrams to solve probability problems, deriving and applying: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B); A and B are mutually exclusive if P(A and B) = 0; A and B are complementary if they are mutually exclusive and P(A) + P(B) = 1, then P(B) = P(not A) = 1 - P(A)

nodes.title: Simple and compound growth
nodes.description: Use the simple and compound growth formulae [A = P(1 + in) and A = P(1 + i)^n] to solve problems, including interest, hire purchase, inflation, population growth and other real-life problems. Understand the implication of fluctuating foreign exchange rates (e.g., on the petrol price, imports, exports, overseas travel)

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: SBA: Test (14%). Final exam: Paper 1 (Algebra 30, Number patterns 15, Finance/growth 10, Functions and graphs 30, Probability 15) and Paper 2 (Statistics 15, Analytical Geometry 15, Trigonometry 40, Euclidean Geometry & Measurement 30)

nodes.title: Volume and surface area of prisms and cylinders
nodes.description: Revise the volume and surface areas of right-prisms and cylinders

nodes.title: Effect of constant factor k
nodes.description: Study the effect on volume and surface area when multiplying any dimension by a constant factor k

nodes.title: Spheres, pyramids, cones and combinations
nodes.description: Calculate the volume and surface areas of spheres, right pyramids, right cones and combination of those objects (figures)

nodes.title: Linear number patterns
nodes.description: Investigate number patterns leading to those where there is a constant difference between consecutive terms, and the general term is therefore linear (without using a formula)
